answer: Work waits on the anchor until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the vertex of the next round. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on token-curated registries for quality signals. Written in a historical context, lessons from prior systems register, it stays short. By the opal of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
